item.title: Comcast benefits from FCC's expedited pole attachment order
item.description: The FCC has issued a first-of-its-kind order resulting from a new, expedited review of pole attachment complaints. The review centered on a dispute between Comcast and Appalachian Power Company. #pressrelease

item.title: SoftBank eyes early rollout of enterprise AI services using OpenAI's Frontier platform
item.description: SoftBank is validating OpenAI's Frontier platform and seeks to use it to speed up its rollout of enterprise AI services in Japan.

item.title: Eurobites: EBU is again trialling 5G broadcast at the Olympics
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: O2 Telefónica pursues sovereign AI for networks; Telenor posts FY 2025 earnings; Ericsson and friends show off their 5G SA at a Taipei gig.

item.title: The Buildout: TDS hits Montana milestone; Spectrum connects more Kentuckians
item.description: This week in broadband builds: TDS network reaches 10,000th Montana customer; Spectrum goes live for thousands in Kentucky; ImOn brings fiber to Fort Madison, Iowa; Comcast completes work in Northeastern Pennsylvania – and more.

item.title: The great convergence: the state of US wireless competition
item.description: The three major wireless carriers now compete on razor-thin profit margins, while cable companies offering mobile service captured 45% of all new wireless customers in 2025. Even after the Sprint and T-Mobile merger, competition in the US is intense.

item.title: KDDI delays result as it probes $1.6B in fake transactions
item.description: KDDI has postponed reporting its earnings and expects to take a $320 million hit after uncovering $1.6 billion worth of false transactions in advertising business.

item.title: Musk denies SpaceX is developing a Starlink phone
item.description: 'We are not developing a phone,' Elon Musk posted on social media in response to a story claiming that SpaceX is exploring the development of a Starlink smartphone. However, Musk has expressed some interest in such a project.

item.title: FirstNet under fire as Congress moves for more oversight
item.description: Verizon calls for more competition and access to FirstNet-funded infrastructure as Congress seeks more oversight in FirstNet reauthorization.

item.title: Open RAN forecast revised up as expectations for future 5G and 6G deployments increase – Dell'Oro
item.description: Cloud RAN and multi-vendor RAN forecast revised downward. #pressrelease

item.title: Mediacom names Giuseppe Commisso as chair and CEO
item.description: The Mediacom board has appointed Giuseppe Commisso as chairman and CEO, succeeding the late Rocco Commisso. Guiseppe Commisso most recently served as vice chairman and interim CEO. #pressrelease
